## Details

<a id="main_loop_draw_status"></a>
### [`main_loop_draw_status`](../../../../src/screen/status_line.asm#L6) `$43BC`

*label*

Writes score, bombs, altitude, speed and fuel to the status rows. The speed is grey and SPEED blinks below the lift-off speed 100.

- **Jumped to from:** [`$43AC`](../../../../src/protection/loader_check.asm#L7), [`$43B3`](../../../../src/protection/loader_check.asm#L21)

<a id="damage_letters"></a>
### [`damage_letters`](../../../../src/screen/status_line.asm#L123) `$44A4-$44A7`

*data*

Damage letters, in the order of the flags $40b9-$40bc: F fuel, B bomb, M motor, G gun.

- **Read by:** [`$4436`](../../../../src/screen/status_line.asm#L65)

<a id="airfield_gap_base"></a>
### [`airfield_gap_base`](../../../../src/screen/status_line.asm#L126) `$44A8-$44AA`

*data*

Base distance to the next airfield for each skill level 0-2.

- **Read by:** [`$446D`](../../../../src/screen/status_line.asm#L93)

<a id="pause_text"></a>
### [`pause_text`](../../../../src/screen/status_line.asm#L129) `$44AB-$44BD`
